task: T222 — BTC Momentum API calculation/model/response/TypeScript contract slice

snippets.description: Vote-to-target logic, completed-bar calculator and response assembly.
snippets.content: _target_for_votes implements the approved score/3 scaling, SMA multiplier and exposure cap; calculate_btc_momentum_signals enforces daily completion, continuity, warm-up, UTC window and target transitions; assembly calculates from BTC bars independently of composite status and attaches the signals field.

snippets.description: Constrained signal event and default-safe response field.
snippets.content: BtcMomentumSignal constrains kind and validates UTC timestamp and finite positive price; BtcLegChartResponse adds default_factory signals.

snippets.description: TypeScript mirror of the additive signal event and chart response contract.
snippets.content: The signal kind is the BUY/SELL literal union; each signal carries only kind, timestamp and price, and the chart response includes the signals list.

snippets.description: Exact target, daily boundary, transition and composite-isolation behavior.
snippets.content: Tests assert exact vote targets, warm-up thresholds, same-bar UTC close anchoring, SMA equality, gaps/duplicates, date boundaries, and signal computation when composite data is unavailable.

snippets.description: Response model/TypeScript parity and narrow BTC-only vocabulary exception.
snippets.content: Contract tests assert exact Pydantic/TypeScript fields and literal kind, reject invalid event values, and preserve the unrelated verdict-word guard outside the BTC API calculator.
